relationships.description: Krys and Jake are Five Oaks founders and parents to Kai and Wes.
Jace and Susanna build a family together and raise Eli, Cole, Sawyer, Dawson, Jennifer, and Caleb.
Luke and Emma are married and are parents to Sami.
Kai and Paloma make their home in a cabin at Five Oaks.
key_moments: Build a cabin beyond the main home

relationships.description: Rhys and Olivia build a secure family life beyond the old Callahan wounds.
Jennifer is drawn to Waya despite insisting that she is not looking for him.
key_moments: Jennifer rides to the Patterson property

relationships.description: Eli's return to Five Oaks begins a difficult but meaningful repair of his relationship with Jace.
Krys trusts Matt with thoughts she cannot always share with Jake because he does not try to control her decisions.
Conrad recognizes Krys's intelligence and offers meaningful work, respect, and partnership.
Roger's harsh treatment of Jace creates years of rejection, anger, and resistance to authority.
Bob gives Marie a marriage built on mutual respect, affection, laughter, and peace.
Whisper recruits and abuses Eli; Eli ultimately kills him while protecting Krys.
key_moments: Eli kills Whisper after Whisper shoots Krys

relationships.description: Tate is Cole Callahan's partner and part of the Five Oaks family that Jace protects.
